source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: The War Dog adds 1 to its **[Hit roll](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls)** if the target is **Below Half-strength**. When the War Dog’s attacks wipe out an enemy unit, check before removing that unit’s last model. All the opponent’s other units within 3″ of the last model must test for Battle-shock.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 7 of 300 sampled combat readings of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.

effects.targets: all other enemy units in range
